Then, to obtain a single prediction, we simply take the average after the burn-in 1)B iterations, f̂(x) = B−Lb=L+1 f̂ b(x). However, it is also possible to compute quantities other than the average: for instance, the percentiles of f̂ L+1(x),⋯, f̂ B(x) provide a measure of uncertainty in the final prediction.
